_planScoreFloor_note: 2026-08-27: makes the documented 'Plan-backed bar = 2' real. inline_trader computes max(planScoreFloor ?? 6, scoreThreshold - planScoreRelief ?? 2); with neither key present that was max(6, 4-2) = 6, i.e. plan-backed entries needed a HIGHER score (6) than ordinary ones (4) — the relief was inverted.
